title: Leonardo da Vinci given information by aliens

tellings.quote: the Talmud. Or take Leonardo da Vinci for example. He was given information as well.

plain: A guest on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced in the 2025 episode title as the president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, says that Leonardo da Vinci, the Italian Renaissance artist and inventor, "was given information" by beings from elsewhere. He names him alongside the Talmud, the body of Jewish religious writings, as an example. If true, some of humanity's great ideas would have come from outside humanity.
